searchText: “hey anthony,i spoke to my contacts at mlb and they have received a few requests on this topic. they are reaching out to jim to gauge his interest and will be back in touch with me. as for the other members of the crew that are currently active umpires, i would ask that you reach out directly to mlb to facilitate that request. we try to make connections when we can but this really isn’t about the charity so i am limited in what i can do.thanks,jsp” kristie ackert
